mapper.update: update activity_registration set status = 'REGISTERED', registered_at = current_timestamp, cancelled_at = null where id = #{id}
update activity_registration set status = #{status}, cancelled_at = case when #{status} = 'CANCELLED' then current_timestamp else cancelled_at end where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select ar.id, ar.activity_id, a.title as activity_title, a.image_url as activity_image_url, a.location as activity_location, a.start_time as activity_start_time, ar.status, ar.registered_at from activity_registration ar inner join activity a on a.id = ar.activity_id where ar.user_id = #{userId} order by ar.registered_at desc, ar.id desc
